Whisperstream curated Kokoro 82M English voice bundle

This archive is assembled by Whisperstream from separately pinned,
permissively licensed artifacts. It is not the unmodified output of any one
upstream project.

Kokoro 82M model and voices
Copyright and attribution remain with the Kokoro contributors.
License: Apache License 2.0
Pinned source model:
https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M/tree/f3ff3571791e39611d31c381e3a41a3af07b4987
ONNX release artifacts:
https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx/releases/tag/model-files-v1.0
Modifications: the FP32 ONNX graph is copied unchanged. The upstream voice NPZ
is deterministically reduced to the nine voice presets listed in
export-manifest.json.

ONNX conversion lineage
The pinned thewh1teagle release identifies taylorchu/kokoro-onnx as the source
of the optimized FP32 ONNX graph.
License: MIT
Source: https://github.com/taylorchu/kokoro-onnx
Exact copyright and permission notice:
licenses/TAYLORCHU-KOKORO-ONNX-MIT.txt
The release repository's own exact MIT notice is retained in
licenses/THEWH1TEAGLE-KOKORO-ONNX-MIT.txt. The Kokoro model and voice artifacts
retain their upstream Apache-2.0 license.

Misaki English lexicons
Copyright and attribution remain with the Misaki contributors.
License: Apache License 2.0
Source:
https://github.com/hexgrad/misaki/tree/fba1236595f2d2bf21d414ba6e57d25256afada3
Modifications: only the US gold and silver pronunciation JSON files are
included. Whisperstream does not distribute the Misaki Python package or its
dependency closure.

English neural G2P fallback
Copyright and attribution remain with Peter Reid and contributors.
License: Apache License 2.0
Source:
https://huggingface.co/PeterReid/graphemes_to_phonemes_en_us/tree/a5631b285d18d59483c32c0c3379cb9fac924f4b
Modifications: the pinned BART model is exported to an ONNX forward graph.
The export configuration and output hashes are recorded in
export-manifest.json.

English averaged perceptron tagger data
Original implementation Copyright 2013 Matthew Honnibal.
NLTK modifications Copyright 2015 The NLTK Project.
NLTK port author: Long Duong.
License: MIT
Source:
https://github.com/nltk/nltk_data/tree/550b6625bcef1f2abff2ff770a5a0d272c9c6b2a/packages/taggers
Implementation source:
https://github.com/nltk/nltk/blob/3.9.1/nltk/tag/perceptron.py
Modifications: the three English JSON data files are copied unchanged.
Whisperstream uses a modified, inference-only implementation. Exact copyright
and permission notice: licenses/NLTK-PERCEPTRON-MIT.txt

Conservative training-data attribution
The pinned Kokoro model card identifies Koniwa `tnc` (CC BY 3.0) and SIWIS
(CC BY 4.0) among the shared model's training sources. None of the nine
American English voice presets curated into this archive is a Koniwa or SIWIS
preset. Whisperstream does not redistribute either dataset. Their attribution,
source links, modification statements, and SIWIS citation are retained in
licenses/TRAINING-DATA-ATTRIBUTION.txt.

Apache NOTICE search
No upstream NOTICE text file was found in the pinned Kokoro model snapshot,
Kokoro source repository, Misaki revision, or PeterReid model snapshot. Apache
License 2.0 section 4(d) therefore does not add an upstream NOTICE pass-through
on the reviewed snapshots. The Apache license copy and the modification notices
required by sections 4(a) through 4(c) are preserved.

This archive's inference frontend does not include or invoke eSpeak,
espeak-ng, phonemizer, piper-phonemize, num2words, Torch, Transformers, spaCy,
NLTK, Misaki, or kokoro-onnx. The included data and ONNX graphs are consumed
by Whisperstream's own lightweight frontend and the ONNX Runtime already used
by the app. The current official sherpa runtime separately includes native
eSpeak/Piper components, attributed in Section 2 of the generated third-party
notices.
